race.comment: SOUTHERN MONARCH (4) returns under a big weight for the Clarken camp but gets the 3kg claimer engaged to offset. Showed promising signs in debut prep and finds a nice race to kick things back off. ALOHA BLUE (10) came with a barnstorming finish to just miss SHARENDIPITY last start at Morphettville. While she doesn't win out of turn, she gets a good pull at the weights over the winner which can see her reverse the result. SHARENDIPITY (3) went forward last start and found plenty when challenged, sticking her head out to get the verdict. Is already a two-time winner here and strips rock-hard fit, though he is conceding weight to a few of these. THE MAGISTRATE (5) just a plain effort first up when tenth over 1050m at Morphettville. Generally goes well with that run under the belt and look for an improved run.
